headline: Twice-yearly HIV prevention shot rolls out in African countries
meta_description: A major advancement in HIV prevention is reaching African nations as a twice-yearly injectable becomes available to those at risk.
summary_short: A twice-yearly HIV prevention shot is now being rolled out across African countries, offering a new tool in the fight against the virus.
body:
A twice-yearly HIV prevention shot is now being rolled out across African countries, marking a significant milestone in HIV prevention efforts on the continent.

This injectable option represents an important expansion of prevention tools available to people at higher risk of infection. The twice-yearly dosing schedule offers a more convenient alternative to daily medication regimens, potentially improving adherence and accessibility for communities across Africa.

The rollout demonstrates growing momentum in the global effort to prevent new HIV infections, bringing medical advances to the regions where prevention efforts are most critically needed.
quick_facts: Twice-yearly injectable HIV prevention becoming available in African countries
New prevention tool offers alternative to daily medication regimens
Rollout focuses on accessible, convenient options for at-risk populations
